From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-09-12T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: NewLeaf artifact plan (KMS & tokenization notes)

Mina / Marissa,

Quick technical note to support the attestation:
- Key model: production model keys are customer-data encryption keys (CEKs) derived and wrapped with a platform master key in our cloud KMS. We maintain an HSM-backed key for master key escrow; split custody exists for root key recovery only.
- Subprocessors that see embeddings/telemetry: analytics vendor (US), logging provider (US), and a backup object store (EU). None of those subprocessors receive raw request payloads or unredacted PII; only hashed identifiers and telemetry aggregates are sent.
- Tokenization: we treat deterministic hashes of email addresses as persistent identifiers; if NewLeaf wants them classified as PII we will mark them in the diagram and in the DPA annex.

Attached: redacted_dataflow_v3.png (labels for storage, caches, and KMS boundaries). I also drafted the short attestation wording: "Redwood Inference holds platform master key in a cloud KMS with HSM-backed escrow; only designated key-ops personnel (5 persons) have split-custody access for recovery under audited procedures."

I will prepare a sanitized sample of access logs for the week of 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-12. ETA: 2026-09-16 for secure transfer.

-Jonas
Senior Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
